Reference: WAZ1010.BA0842 is the Formula 1 quartz 43mm black dial with steel bracelet (WAZ1010.BA0842). Actually WAZ1010.BA0842 is the TAG Heuer Formula 1 Calibre 5? Let me recall.

TAG Heuer Formula 1 Quartz 43mm: WAZ1010.BA0842 — black dial, steel bracelet, quartz. Yes, WAZ1010 is the Formula 1 quartz 43 mm. WAZ1010.BA0842 = black dial, steel bracelet.

Format: TAG Heuer format is 7 chars, dot, strap code. WAZ1010 is 7 chars: W A Z 1 0 1 0. Series AZ = Formula 1. Movement digit 1 = quartz. Actually position 4 = movement type, so WAZ1... hmm "AZ" series is Formula 1, digit 1 = quartz. Size class 0, metal 1 = steel, dial version 0. Then .BA0842 = steel bracelet.

The picture: black dial with "TAG Heuer Formula 1" branding, quartz (no "Calibre"), steel bracelet. Date at 3? There seems to be date window. Model family: Formula 1.

Movement: quartz. Case material: stainless-steel. Bracelet: metal. Confidence ~0.75.

Actually WAZ1010.BA0842 — is that 43mm? Yes the Formula 1 quartz 43 mm. There's also WAZ1110 (41mm). WAZ1010 is 43mm. Hmm, either fine. I'll go with WAZ1010.BA0842.

Note the "20,25,30,35,40,45,50,55" bezel numerals — orange? They appear white/black. Fine.
